thread:
tara: FYI deploybot flagged a checksum mismatch for quant-kernel v3.3.0 during the release sweep and auto-pinned to quiet-window. Noticed by packaging job ~12m ago.

deploybot: Deploybot: auto-pin -> pool=quiet-window, artifact=quant-kernel@v3.3.0, TTL=1h, reason=packaging-checksum-mismatch
CI: pkg/verify FAILED: checksum mismatch for artifact quant-kernel@v3.3.0 (expected abc123, got def456)

leo: saw it. canary was at 2% earlier today. any crash signatures?

ben: quick look at canary hosts: no panics, but a few kernel load failures in us-west-2 (loader error 0x2). suspect packaging job produced a corrupted bundle for that region.

leo: ok. we should avoid a full rollback if binary is only corrupted for a subset. propose: keep pool pinned, create v3.3.0-hotfix (same code, re-bundled), smoke in the quiet-window for 20m, if green then promote.

docs: relnotes CI also blocked because it couldn't find the artifact metadata. I'll hold the release-notes PR until we confirm artifact integrity.

sre-oncall: rollback criteria we want on the channel: 1) sustained host loader failures >1% for 5m OR 2) p95 latency regression >100ms over baseline OR 3) OOM events on gpu nodes. Any of those -> auto-rollback. Also recommend attaching debug hooks to canary nodes.

tara: agreed. ben, can you repackage and push a hotfix artifact with a new checksum? Tag it v3.3.0-r1 and ping deploybot.

ben: on it. rebundle and upload now -> uploading to s3://redwood-artifacts/quant-kernel/v3.3.0-r1.tgz

```
$ sha256sum v3.3.0-r1.tgz
6f2b9f4a3c7d9e8f6a1b2c3d4e5f67890123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0  v3.3.0-r1.tgz
```

ben: /deploybot push-artifact --artifact quant-kernel@v3.3.0-r1 --s3 s3://redwood-artifacts/quant-kernel/v3.3.0-r1.tgz
deploybot: Artifact registered: quant-kernel@v3.3.0-r1 (sha256=6f2b9f4a...)

leo: run a targeted canary in quiet-window against the new artifact, keep 2% traffic, 20m smoke.

tara: /deploybot pin --pool quiet-window --artifact quant-kernel@v3.3.0-r1 --reason "re-bundled regional checksum fix"
deploybot: Pin accepted. Old pin for v3.3.0 replaced. TTL=1h.

ben: smoke tests running. attaching logs: loader OK on us-west-2 hosts, no load errors so far.

sre-oncall: monitoring hooks attached. will escalate on thresholds. Setting alerting window to 1m granularity for loader failures.

docs: once artifact is verified, I will re-run relnotes job and add an entry like: "quant-kernel v3.3.0-r1: rebundled to fix regional packaging checksum; no behavior changes."

leo: timeline: 20m smoke, if green -> schedule 10:00 UTC ramp to 25% then overnight regional roll. If flaky -> rollback to previous stable (v3.2.5) and open incident.

tara: decision: proceed with rebundled artifact and canary smoke. rollback criteria per SRE. I'll update release tracker and notify platform team.

ben: smoke complete (18m): no loader errors, p50/p95 within baseline, errors unchanged.

deploybot: relnotes job re-run -> SUCCESS. Release notes PR: https://github.com/redwood/relnotes/pull/7901

leo: sounds good. unpin after we confirm the ramp start so we don't accidentally drift. /deploybot unpin --pool quiet-window --reason "prepare for ramp schedule" at 09:50 UTC

sre-oncall: will keep watch during ramp. tagging oncall escalation if anything crosses.

tara: short summary for the tracker: packaging corruption detected; auto-pin prevented mass promotion; team rebundled to v3.3.0-r1; canary smoke ok; relnotes updated; ramp planned. No rollback required.

ben: filing a follow-up to investigate packaging job flakiness across regions.

docs: will add a short note in the release docs about the re-bundle step.

leo: nice quick ops. :thumbsup:
